fusions.name: Stamping Ring
fusions.desc: Stamps the reef flat, dealing 6 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds. Holds 5 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Kicked-Up Shard
fusions.desc: Kicks a shard of reef at the first enemy in its path that deals 30 damage. It ignores resistances. Its damage rises 10% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 50%).

fusions.name: Unflagging Tide
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 40% for 20 seconds, and restores 8 health at once.

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Reserve
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, 2 stamina a second comes back to you for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.
